01 · The beginning

Our story

Some love stories begin with a grand gesture. Ours began a little more quietly — with a conversation, a little curiosity, and two people who decided to see where it might lead.

Somewhere along the way, we discovered that love isn’t always about being alike — it’s about finding someone who brings you a sense of calmness, makes you laugh, challenges you to grow, and reminds you what truly matters.

As our story unfolded, so did the distance between Penang and Kuala Lumpur — a new chapter that taught us to be intentional with our time, to cherish the moments we share, and to look forward to the day when goodbyes become a little less frequent.

Through it all, we’ve been reminded that the best things in life don’t always happen according to our own timelines. Sometimes, God’s grace brings two people together in ways they could never have planned themselves.

And now, here we are — two imperfect people, choosing each other and trusting God with all the ordinary and extraordinary days to come.

Our story is only just beginning, and we’re so grateful to have you be part of this next chapter.

How grace has found us.
And now love will lead us home.

T&E
02 · Get to know us

Q&A

When did you realise this was something special?

Somewhere between the conversations that never seemed to run out and the quiet realisation that we wanted to keep making room for each other.

What is your favourite chapter of your story so far?

The one we’re in right now — with all the anticipation, the little preparations, and the beautiful uncertainty of everything still to come.

Who takes out the rubbish?

Whoever’s nearest the bin :)

What does a Christ-centred marriage mean to you?

A marriage where love is more than a feeling — where we learn to practise patience, extend grace, forgive freely, and keep turning towards God and each other.

What does your perfect ordinary day look like?

No elaborate plans required. Good food, unhurried conversations, a little adventure, time together, and the comfort of knowing we’re right where we belong.

What makes you a good team?

We may not always think alike, but we’re learning that being on the same team matters more than always seeing things the same way.

Who fell in love first?

We might have different versions of the timeline. What matters is that we eventually arrived at the same answer.

What would you like your guests to know?

That we’re grateful to have people like you in our lives. This day celebrates our love, but it also celebrates the family, friendships, and community that have helped shape us.
